name: Penetration Test Authorization
description: An authorization and rules of engagement for a security test, signed by the testing firm, Fontara's CISO and the hosting provider before testing begins.

fields.text: **Test name:** put it in the request title above the form, for example: 2026 annual penetration test.

fields.label: Testing firm
fields.description: The testing firm's legal name, as on its agreement with Fontara.

fields.label: Related agreement
fields.description: The agreement the test is performed under, for example: Master Services Agreement dated 11/07/2023 and the 2026 Statement of Work.

fields.label: Testing firm signer name
fields.description: The person who signs for the testing firm, usually its managing director. Signs first.

fields.label: Systems in scope
fields.description: Applications, APIs, hostnames, IP ranges and environments the testers may test.

fields.label: Out of scope
fields.description: Systems the testers must not touch: the hosting provider's shared infrastructure, other customers' environments, third-party services.

fields.label: Testing starts
fields.description: Most hosting providers need the request 10 business days before this date.

fields.label: Testing hours
fields.description: Days and hours, with the time zone, for example: Monday to Friday, 8:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. Eastern Time.

fields.label: Source IP addresses
fields.description: The addresses all test traffic will come from.

fields.label: Hosting provider
fields.description: The provider whose services the systems in scope run on. It approves the test and signs last.

fields.label: Hosting provider approver name
fields.description: The person at the hosting provider who approves customer security testing.

fields.label: Fontara emergency contact
fields.description: Name, title and a phone number answered during testing hours.

fields.label: Testing firm emergency contact
fields.description: Name, title and a phone number answered during testing hours.

fields.label: Business owner
fields.description: The Fontara person accountable for the test, who gets the daily status. Name and title.

fields.label: Cost center
fields.description: The cost center that pays, e.g. 5200-IT Security.
